data_scope: Existing verified 010-B BTC/ETH Jan-Jun2025; Jan warmup; Feb-Mar DEV only. All other prior data are SEEN, never new OOS.
new_code_pin: Must publish exact new commit before first new DEV diagnostic run; no OOS execution permitted by this protocol.

partition.DEV: 2025-02-01 <= decision < 2025-04-01; reject outcomes ending at/after boundary
partition.old_OOS: 2025-04-01/2025-07-01 frozen replay audit only, never refit or revise inference
partition.new_OOS: PENDING: no documented untouched licensed PIT-qualified holdout is currently available
partition.future_OOS: Requires distinct frozen artifact manifest and code and actual fresh evidence; old re-splits forbidden

estimand: Equal-asset mean of paired Pearson correlation(B,directional gross outcome)-correlation(A,same outcome), separately by horizon and direction
outcome: First full5m open strictly after close+60s to exact1h Intraday or24h Swing close; gross label, no short trade or executable P&L

comparisons.I4: QvsR,QvsD,RvsD,A-half-share vs equal mean(A,Q_DEV baseRVOL),A vs equal mean(A,Q_DEV quoteRVOL), each separately UP and DOWN =10
comparisons.I2_S3_S4: Frozen A vs frozen B each separately UP/DOWN =6
comparisons.I6_S6_reserved: QvsR each separately UP/DOWN =4; absent qualified liquidity => unavailable, retain family cap

calibration: Q midrank DEV; R median/MAD atan DEV; D intrinsic[0,1] only. Direction and horizon separate. Flat MAD/missing input => null. No normalizer chosen using OOS.
setups: Keep 010 candidate Early/Continuation/Reversal/Negative/Unknown definitions and frozen causal pivots; descriptive strata only by asset/direction/setup/daily regime. No p-values or winner selection within strata.
dependence: Event identity asset+horizon+close; UP/DOWN are two views, not independent events. Match intraweek slots and retain only groups with >=3 comparable weeks for DEV diagnostics. Asset-specific week rotations preserve within-week order; exchangeability is UNVERIFIED.
sample_plan: Two-sided Bonferroni20 paired-block normal known-SD reference; standardized paired effect0.25, alpha0.05,power0.8. Compute N_reference=ceil(((z(1-alpha/(2*20))+z(.8))/.25)^2). This is theoretical independent blocks, not observed Neff or a guarantee for correlation-delta estimates.
calibration_probes: 4096 IID-normal and stationary AR(.5) replicates under null/effect. Known-unit-SD reference only; stress failures do not imply a qualifying market test. Actual N_effective and N_REQUIRED_actual remain null until estimand variance/dependence are justified.
costs: 0/5/10bps each way hypothetical sensitivity only, not measured spread/slippage/fill costs
qualification: No automatic PASS. New OOS must exceed practical floor with correctly calibrated familywise interval, survive both direction/horizon and preregistered setup/regime checks, satisfy actual paired power, PIT and liquidity gates, independent review and owner approval. No full V2 while I6/S6 or timing absent.
forbidden: claim quote updates as independent samples
